capabilities: Chats about and edits vault notes over several steps
Undoes a reply's note changes in one command
Turns photos, scans and PDFs into Markdown notes
Writes and grades questions from your notes on an FSRS schedule
Shares the study record with Claude Code, Codex and other agents
disambiguation: Not only a quiz tool: it is also an AI agent that reads, searches and edits notes.
extras: Grill Cloud is a paid monthly plan ($7.99/month) with free trial credits and optional credit packs; detailed documentation lives in a separate docs/ folder, and a matching Obsidian theme is included.
motivation: I take a lot of notes to learn new material, and I needed a way to learn them more deeply.
problem: Notes get written but rarely revisited, and Obsidian has no built-in way to ask an AI about the vault or to test your recall of what it holds.
